title: Rational Hearing
idiom: a hand-inked lecture sheet: the zigzag ladder of partials drawn in brush pen on cream paper, one rung lit in engineering red; icon as a bold linocut 3:2 with a vibrating string under it
hero_prompt: Hand-drawn lecture sheet in black brush pen on warm cream paper, flat and graphic, hand-made, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no gradients, no depth-of-field: a tall zigzag ladder of large hand-lettered numerals 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 15, 16 climbing down the left two-thirds of the frame, each pair joined by a thin pen line with a small boxed label on it, one line and its two numerals inked in a single spot of engineering red. To the right, three small sketches stacked: a string vibrating in two and three loops, two short tubes of different lengths, and a spiky spectrum with tall thin peaks falling away to the right. Along the bottom edge, a row of piano keys drawn as thin dashed lines with short black bars sitting just off them. Nothing else: no photographs, no colour but black, cream and one red.
icon_prompt: Linocut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a warm cream ground, no shading or gradients: the numerals 3 over 2 as a stacked fraction with a thick horizontal bar between them, filling the upper two-thirds of the square, and below them one thick black wavy line with exactly three loops like a string vibrating in its third mode. Nothing else. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
